description: Submit a task for review. Changes status to 'ready_for_review'. Pass progress to log what you did and finish in one call. Next step is accept_task / reject_task under the active autonomy mode (human_review, peer_review, or full).

comment.description: Older option: a plain completion comment. Prefer progress.

progress.description: Handoff note for the reviewer, saved as a progress update with the status change. For blockers, use log_progress and don't finish.

checks.description: Test or check results at this point, e.g. { passed: 42, total: 42, label: "vitest" }. Shown on the Now view.

whatFailed.description: What didn't work or was left out, and why

whatSucceeded.description: What worked, e.g. tests that pass

name: finish_task
